goals.description: Run image segmentation inference efficiently on a GPU workstation

metrics.description: GPU memory, GPU power, and CPU utilization stay within inference limits

system.task: Segment damaged regions in infrastructure inspection images
system.usage_context: The model runs on an NVIDIA GPU workstation used by inspection engineers to process batches of infrastructure images
risks: Inference may exceed available GPU memory
Inference may draw too much GPU power during batch processing
CPU usage may interfere with other inspection tools on the workstation

fields.name: file name
fields.expected_values: PNG or JPG image file path

model.capability_deployment_mechanism: The model is called by a local batch inference script

input_specification.name: file name
input_specification.expected_values: PNG or JPG image file path

output_specification.name: Damage mask
output_specification.description: Predicted segmentation mask for damaged region

system_requirements.stimulus: The GPU inference process runs on the inspection workstation
system_requirements.response: The inference process uses GPU memory within the available budget
system_requirements.measure: the maximum NVIDIA GPU memory utilization is less than 10 GB

system_requirements.stimulus: The GPU inference process runs on the inspection workstation
system_requirements.response: The inference process keeps average GPU power usage within the workstation budget
system_requirements.measure: the average NVIDIA GPU power utilization is less than 250 watts

system_requirements.stimulus: The GPU inference process runs on the inspection workstation
